author: ETA PRIME
description:
n this video, we are putting together an awesome, pocket-sized cyberdeck for under $100. By repurposing a waterproof mini tackle box, a dual-mode mini RGB keyboard, and an older Samsung Galaxy S10, you can build a highly capable portable PC with minimal tools and absolutely zero 3D printing.

3 pack of the case I used: https://link.amazon/B07Ik9A2Y
Buy A Used Galaxy S10: https://ebay.us/Wy9UwN
